demos.title: Data to report
demos.description: Seeded CSV generation, Python aggregation, a Markdown/JSON report kept as a Directory artifact and archived by a nested graph. Includes an intentional failure switch.

demos.title: Collatz (C++ / Python)
demos.description: The same feedback loop implemented in C++ and Python inside two nested graphs, with merge, fork and branch. 27 reaches 1 after 111 steps; both sequences are compared and kept as a CSV file. The Collatz conjecture is explained on a note with formulas.

demos.title: Live Stream
demos.description: A seeded random walk sampled every 100 ms and drawn with Dawn as a live line chart, through a feedback loop that can be cancelled at any time.

demos.title: Plots (matplotlib, Plotly, Altair)
demos.description: Random walks drawn by plotting code written as it would be anywhere else: matplotlib's plt.show() and a FuncAnimation that plays live, Plotly's fig.show() and Altair's chart.show() as interactive plots (zoom, hover). No Tsugumi-specific plotting calls.

demos.title: Cas A · Chandra RGB
demos.description: Chandra X-ray events of the supernova remnant Cassiopeia A, fixed by Nix (fetched once by hash from the HEASARC archive), split into three energy bands on a sky grid centred on Cas A and composed into an RGB image. ObsID 25628 (13 MB) by default; 114 is the deep 50 ks observation.

demos.title: Cas A · Chandra RGB（Draft）
demos.description: The same plan as Drafts only: a start Card and three Drafts that state what each step takes and gives, ready for the Agent's "Card を生成".

demos.title: GW150914 · 重力波
demos.description: The first binary black hole merger seen by LIGO: the public H1 and L1 strain data are fetched, whitened and shown as a chirp in a spectrogram. The pass band can be changed and that step rerun alone.

demos.title: GW150914 · 重力波（Draft）
demos.description: The same plan as Drafts only: a start Card and three Drafts that state what each step takes and gives, ready for the Agent's "Card を生成".

demos.title: 6LU7 · タンパク質と結合ポケット
demos.description: The SARS-CoV-2 main protease with its inhibitor (PDB 6LU7): the structure is fetched from the PDB, drawn, and the residues within a distance of the ligand are listed.

demos.title: 6LU7 · タンパク質と結合ポケット（Draft）

demos.title: Kepler-6 b · 系外惑星トランジット
demos.description: Kepler light curves of Kepler-6 are detrended and folded at the planet's period; the transit depth gives the planet's size relative to its star.

demos.title: Kepler-6 b · 系外惑星トランジット（Draft）
demos.description: The same plan as Drafts only: a start Card and three Drafts that state what each step takes and gives, ready for the Agent's "Card を生成".

demos.title: 日本海溝 · 震源断面と b 値
demos.description: USGS earthquakes along the Japan Trench: a depth section across the trench shows the subducting slab, and the Gutenberg–Richter b value is fitted.

demos.title: 日本海溝 · 震源断面と b 値（Draft）
demos.description: The same plan as Drafts only: a start Card and three Drafts that state what each step takes and gives, ready for the Agent's "Card を生成".

demos.title: MNIST · 手書き数字の分類器くらべ
demos.description: The real MNIST, fixed by Nix, sent down seven branches at once: kNN, logistic regression, an RBF SVM, a random forest, gradient boosting, an MLP and a small CNN, each Card in its own Nix environment on one CPU thread. They meet at a comparison: a leaderboard that says whether the gap means anything, accuracy against time, per-digit recall and the digits most models get wrong.

demos.title: Newton 法 · 初期値と収束
demos.description: Newton's method on z^3 - 1 in the complex plane: error against iteration from a list of starts with the order estimated numerically, the fractal basins of attraction with iteration counts, and the cases that lose quadratic convergence or never converge (a start near a critical point, a double root, a 2-cycle). Checked against the exact roots.

demos.title: 薬物動態 · 架空の薬物ツグミシン
demos.description: A one-compartment oral model of a fictional drug (a teaching model, not medical advice or dosing guidance): several dosing regimens side by side in an interactive plot, accumulation to steady state, peak and trough against a made-up window and missed doses. The numerical solution is compared with the closed-form superposition and the steady-state accumulation ratio.

demos.title: 最大流と最小カット
demos.description: A seeded synthetic layered network: the maximum flow by networkx, the minimum cut with max-flow = min-cut asserted, both drawn on the network, verified by scipy and a brute force over all cuts. Raising an edge off the cut changes nothing; a comparison Card and a sweep over every edge show which edges do move the result.

demos.title: 濃度–反応曲線
demos.description: A four-parameter logistic fit to seeded synthetic plate data for two fictional compounds, with residual-bootstrap intervals on the EC50 and Hill slope and their relative potency. The intervals contain the true values, and blow up with a warning when the concentration range does not bracket the EC50.

demos.title: 分子の物性
demos.description: RDKit computes molecular weight, Crippen logP, TPSA and hydrogen-bond counts for well-known molecules given as SMILES, draws them, checks Lipinski's rule of five, plots weight against logP interactively and compares Morgan fingerprints. Paste a new SMILES and rerun; an invalid one gets a clear message instead of a crash.

demos.title: 細胞画像の計数
demos.description: Seeded synthetic fluorescence-like images with known cell centres: background subtraction, Otsu threshold and a distance-transform watershed, scored by matching to the true centres. Threshold alone against watershed, and a sweep over density and noise that shows where the method fails. The same steps also run on a real image of nuclei fixed by Nix.

demos.title: 力学系ギャラリー（Draft）
demos.description: Six independent calculations (Lorenz, Mandelbrot, logistic map, Game of Life, Gray–Scott, double pendulum) as Drafts that only share their settings: the Agent's "Card を生成" hands them to helpers that write them at the same time, a bird each.
